description: A user executed a process associated with user account creation.
investigative_actions: Check the user who created the account and verify its activity. Investigate whether the same account was created on different hosts as part of an installation process.
name: Linux local user account creation

variations.name: Linux local user account creation by non-root user
variations.description: A non-root user executed a process associated with user account creation. This user does not regularly create accounts.
variations.investigative_actions: Check the user who created the account and verify its activity. Investigate whether the same account was created on different hosts as part of an installation process.
